offering_description.value: Provides hands-on technical training and diploma or degree programs that prepare students for careers in automotive, diesel, collision repair, motorcycle, marine, HVAC, welding and healthcare. Sells tuition-based education to students, with some programs developed with manufacturer and employer partners, and delivers instruction mainly at its own campuses.

primary_services.value: technical training; career placement assistance; continuing education

customer_segment.value: B2C: prospective students and career changers seeking technical or healthcare training; B2B: manufacturer and dealer employers sponsoring or recruiting trained graduates

end_markets.value: automotive; diesel and heavy equipment; collision repair; marine; HVAC; welding; healthcare

revenue_model.value: service fees: tuition and fees students pay for training programs; other: federal student aid disbursed to the school for eligible students' tuition

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells career training to students, who pay tuition, often with employer and manufacturer partner support

geography_served.value: US national: campuses across many US states, with online programs available nationally

specialization.value: related lines: automotive, diesel, collision, motorcycle, marine, HVAC and welding training, Concorde healthcare programs

distribution_channels.value: own locations: training campuses operated across the United States; online: online and hybrid programs for students who cannot attend campus

regulatory_exposure.value: high: accreditation and state education approvals plus US Department of Education federal student aid eligibility rules

notes: Campus count and exact program mix may have changed since my information was last updated.
